title: The Last Order
victim: Erwin Smith, Commander of the Survey Corps
teaser: An expedition beyond the Wall, a night in the Forest of Giant Trees. The squad sleeps on the branches, and down by the trunks the Titans doze. At 03:10 a black flare went up over the camp, the signal for an Abnormal Titan, but there was no Titan. Instead, Commander Erwin Smith had vanished. He was found below the camp, hanging from a single wire: the other had been cut. At dawn the Titans will wake, and the killer is still sleeping among their comrades.

habits.label: Red scarf
habits.habit: Never takes off their red scarf, even to sleep
clues: A red wool thread is caught on a twig by the low branch. The culprit wears a red scarf.
The lookout saw something red, like a scarf, slip towards the rope ladder in the dark. The culprit wears a red scarf.

habits.label: Holds a cup by the rim
habits.habit: Drinks tea holding the cup by the rim, not the handle
clues: There's a second cup on the command branch, and the only fingerprints on it are round the rim. The culprit holds their cup by the rim.
Before the flare the cook saw someone by the rope ladder calmly drinking tea, holding the cup by the rim. The culprit holds their cup by the rim.

habits.label: Smokes a pipe
habits.habit: Smokes a pipe, though it's forbidden on expeditions
clues: There's pipe ash scattered on the bark by the low branch. The culprit smokes a pipe.
The lookout smelled tobacco smoke by the rope ladder shortly before the flare. The culprit smokes a pipe.

habits.label: Sap on the palms
clues: The grip of the flare gun has sticky smears of sap. The culprit has sap on their palms.
Erwin's wire has a sappy fingerprint right by the cut. The culprit has sap on their palms.

habits.label: Prays to the Walls
habits.habit: Every evening whispers prayers to the Walls
clues: The lookout heard whispering by the rope ladder: someone was praying to the Walls. The culprit prays to the Walls.
Knotted prayer beads lie by the low branch. The culprit prays to the Walls.

habits.label: Fallen comrades' tags
habits.habit: Wears the tags of fallen friends round their neck; they clink with every step
clues: Under the command branch lies a fallen scout's tag on a broken chain. The culprit wears the tags of the fallen.
Before the flare the lookout heard a soft clink of metal by the rope ladder. The culprit wears the tags of the fallen.

habits.label: Potatoes in the pockets
habits.habit: Hides boiled potatoes in their pockets
clues: A bitten boiled potato lies by the cut wire. The culprit carries potatoes around.
The cook found potatoes missing from the pot, and the peel turned up by the flare box. The culprit carries potatoes around.

habits.label: Draws in charcoal
habits.habit: Spends every spare minute drawing Titans in charcoal
clues: Erwin's gas canisters have black charcoal fingerprints. The culprit draws in charcoal.
There's a fresh charcoal sketch of a Titan on the bark of the low branch. The culprit draws in charcoal.

habits.label: Left-handed
habits.habit: Left-handed, holds the blade in their left hand
clues: The wire was cut from right to left, the way a left-hander cuts. The culprit is left-handed.
The knot on the rope used to climb down to the low branch was tied left-handed. The culprit is left-handed.

habits.label: Bandaged head
habits.habit: Head bandaged after the last expedition
clues: A scrap of bandage with a brown stain hangs on a twig by the low branch. The culprit has a bandaged head.
The flare box has a smear of weeping wound and a thread from a bandage. The culprit has a bandaged head.

habits.label: Coughs
habits.habit: Coughs from the night damp and can't stop
clues: The lookout heard a stifled cough by the rope ladder a minute before the flare. The culprit coughs.
The medic was awake and noticed someone coughing at the edge of the platform, then going quiet and disappearing. The culprit coughs.

habits.label: Wears glasses
habits.habit: Can't see past arm's length without glasses
clues: A shard of spectacle lens glints on the low branch. The culprit wears glasses.
The lookout saw the lenses of a pair of glasses flash in the moonlight by the rope ladder. The culprit wears glasses.

habits.label: Very tall
habits.habit: A head taller than anyone else in the squad
clues: The flare was taken from a hook an ordinary person can't reach. The culprit is very tall.
Above the low branch a twig is snapped at over two metres: someone hit it with their head. The culprit is very tall.

habits.label: Sharpens blades at night
habits.habit: Spends ages sharpening blades before bed
clues: Steel dust from a whetstone is scattered on the low branch. The culprit sharpens blades at night.
In the night someone spent a long time sharpening a blade, and the sound broke off just before the flare. The culprit sharpens blades at night.

habits.label: Earring
habits.habit: Wears a small silver ring in one ear
clues: A small silver earring lies under the command branch. The culprit wears an earring.
An earring back was found by the cut wire. The culprit wears an earring.

habits.label: Wrapped in a blanket
habits.habit: Always cold, always wrapped in a blanket
clues: There's grey fluff from an army blanket on the bark by the low branch. The culprit wraps up in a blanket.
The lookout saw a figure by the rope ladder wrapped head to toe in a blanket. The culprit wraps up in a blanket.

strong: Erwin was carried down to the low branch by hand, without gear: the bark shows deep boot prints of someone bearing a heavy load. The culprit is physically strong.
The crate of spare canisters weighs over thirty kilos, and it was used to block the rope ladder so nobody could follow. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: The branch under the sleeping platform creaks at every step, yet none of the sleepers woke. The culprit moves silently.
The horses by the roots can smell people and always snort, but that night they were silent. The culprit moves silently.
tools: Erwin's gear reel was taken apart and put back together, only the spring went in back to front. The culprit is good with mechanisms.
The wire's anchor was bent so that it holds on to the bark but tears loose at the first jerk. The culprit is good with mechanisms.
medic: Erwin sleeps lightly but didn't hear the footsteps: someone mixed a sleeping draught into his flask. The culprit knows medicine.
Erwin's body hasn't a single bruise, but he lost consciousness before he fell. That happens when you know where to press. The culprit knows medicine.
keys: The flare box is kept locked, with keys only held by the signaller and at headquarters. It was opened with a key, not forced. The culprit had a key.
The route map is gone from the locked command chest, and the lock is still shut. The culprit had a key.
safe: Right after the black flare a green one went up towards the river, as if ordering a retreat that way. Only headquarters regulations use that signal. The culprit knows the scouts' signals.
In Erwin's pocket there's a note in the scouts' code: "Below, at three." The culprit knows the scouts' signals.
sched: It all happened between lookout shifts, when nobody was at the treetop. The culprit knows the camp routine.
Erwin was called down right at the time of his night round, which only insiders knew about. The culprit knows the camp routine.
tech: The flare gun was tied to a branch and lit with a long fuse: whoever fired it had time to get back to the platform and lie down. The culprit understands fuses and valves.
The valve on Erwin's canisters was filed: gas leaked out in a thin stream, and by night the canisters were empty. The culprit understands fuses and valves.
cash: Two spare canisters went missing from the supply train, though they're counted every evening. The culprit has access to the supply train.
Erwin's canisters were found in a sack of hardtack, and only those in charge of the supply train look in its sacks. The culprit has access to the supply train.
passages: Someone went down not by the rope ladder but by a vine along the trunk, which only the lookouts know about. The culprit knows the hidden paths through the trees.
A wire forgotten from the last expedition hangs between the trunks, and someone used it to cross to the low branch. The culprit knows the hidden paths through the trees.
